notable_absence.finding: The page instructs the reader to create 'the database credentials to access the travel-sample bucket (Read and Write) used in the application' but never names a specific Capella role or privilege (no privilege:* or capella-role:* id is stated) - it defers entirely to the linked database-users management page rather than stating an access requirement inline, consistent with this batch's general pattern of tutorial pages deferring privilege specifics to reference pages outside this batch's scope.

cross_component_finding: The 'Extending API by Adding New Entity' appendix explicitly frames creating a new Couchbase collection as doable 'using the [SDK] or via the [Couchbase Server interface]' - a clean, explicit statement of the same SDK-vs-UI dual-surface pattern already captured elsewhere in this batch (sdk:bucket-management wrapping the equivalent server-side operation).
cross_product_finding: This page runs the identical quickstart against both a Couchbase Capella cluster (the primary documented path) and a self-managed Couchbase Server 7+ cluster (the 'Running Self-Managed Couchbase Cluster' appendix): 'Couchbase Server version 7 or higher must be installed and running before running the Spring Boot Java app.' The only stated difference is where sample-bucket loading and credential generation happen; the Spring Boot application code itself is unchanged either way.
